description: Music composed as code with the editor's DAW, delivered as mastered audio. Adds @volter/dawproject (a piece is a React component of DAWproject elements) and @volter/editor-dawproject (the piece document, the renderer and the checks), the vgai-music skill, and src/lib/music/music-player.ts, which plays a render's loops, section loops switched on the bar line, stems and stingers through the game's own Web Audio graph. Select the finder in vgai.adapter.ts: { finder: 'piecesFromModules', include: ['src/music/**/*.tsx'] }.
title: Music (rendered pieces)
